name: Who We Are
overview: Scripture reveals that human identity is rooted in being created in the image and likeness of God, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, where God made mankind male and female. Our existence is intimately known and formed by God, who shaped us in the womb (Psalms 139:13). Through faith in Christ Jesus, we become children of God (Galatians 3:26) and are His workmanship, created for good works prepared in advance (Ephesians 2:10). Empowered by God's love, we are more than conquerors in all circumstances (Romans 8:37), reflecting our secure and purposeful identity in Him.
